meta.take: first candidate of the day (time order; same minute: highest score) with score >= threshold; then nothing more that day

feature_doc.vega_pct: that contract's premium change for +1 IV point, % of premium

feature_doc.post_us_event: 1 on the first session after a US FOMC decision or US CPI release
feature_doc.other_expiry_today: 1 when another of NIFTY / BANKNIFTY / FINNIFTY / MIDCPNIFTY expires today
feature_doc.fii_fut_long_share: FII index-futures long share, previous session's NSE participant OI
feature_doc.fii_fut_long_chg: its change from the session before
